scope: Independent rawGLB to frozen face/UV/coordinate mapping for2342selected triangles and decoded originalWebP/barycentric witness verification. This is not full texture-interior coverage or semantic hair proof.
mapping_rule: glTF(x,y,z)->Blender(x,-z,y); glTF UV(u,v)->Blender(u,1-v). Exact source face index with cyclic corner rotations,2e-6 float tolerance.
prior_reviewer_method_error: Initial diagnostic compared unflipped glTF V against BlenderV, so all face matches failed. It is retained separately and is not a source defect.
